title: Daddy's Roommate
author: Michael Willhoite
current_text: In Queens, N.Y., a school board voted unanimously to reject the first-grade curriculum “Children of the Rainbow” because its bibliography listed Daddy’s Roommate and two other titles.

sources.quote: Queens, N.Y.: Only in the culturally diverse city of New York did authorities back down, and it was a school board, not a library, that did so. The school board voted unanimously to reject a first-grade curriculum entitled "Children of the Rainbow," because its bibliography listed three Alyson Wonderland titles: Daddy's Roommate, Heather Has Two Mommies, and Gloria Goes to Gay Pride.
